title: Widefield trial metadata
description: Metadata extracted from a widefield imaging trial (e.g. from data.h5 or saved metadata.json). Used for processed and raw trial data.

source_h5.description: Original HDF5 file path (or path from which metadata was extracted).

trial_name.description: Name of the trial (typically the parent folder name).

file_attributes.description: File-level HDF5 attributes (e.g. mouse_id, protocol_name, comment, camera_fps).

comment.description: Free-form comment (may contain parsed temp range).

datasets.description: Per-dataset info (shape, dtype, attributes). Keys are dataset names.

dtype.description: NumPy dtype as string (e.g. float64, uint16).

attributes.description: Dataset-level HDF5 attributes (e.g. sr for sample rate).

parsed.description: Optional parsed fields (e.g. temperature range from comment).
